components.name: Primary Action CTA
components.description: High-priority execution button (e.g., Run Waterfall Reconciliation).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00D2FF, #38E1FF); color: #000000; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.2); transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 210, 255, 0.35); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Status Pill (Matched)
components.description: High-contrast indicator for verified auto-matched transactions.
components.css: .ds-pill-matched { background: rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.6); color: #10B981; border: 1px solid rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.6); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot-matched { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #10B981; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.6); }

components.name: Status Pill (Exception)
components.description: Indicator for quarantined files or statement breaks.
components.css: .ds-pill-exception { background: rgba(76, 5, 25, 0.6); color: #F43F5E; border: 1px solid rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.6); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-dot-exception { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F43F5E; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.6); }

narrative.overview: Recon Master is built for enterprise treasury and financial operations teams who execute high-volume multi-bank reconciliations under strict close deadlines. The interface treats raw financial data as the primary design material: zero decorative fluff, authoritative dark obsidian surfaces, and high-contrast luminous semantic beacons that enable instant break triage.
keyCharacteristics: Strict Semantic Differentiation (Emerald, Rose, Amber, Sky, Purple)
Monospace Financial Geometry with Tabular Numerals

rules.name: The Strict Semantic Exclusivity Rule
rules.body: Semantic status colors (Emerald, Rose, Amber) are strictly prohibited on decorative or non-status elements. Color in Recon Master always communicates financial truth.

rules.name: The Tabular Number Invariant
rules.body: All numerical, currency, date, and identifier values must be rendered in font-mono with font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1, 'zero' 1; and right-aligned in tables to guarantee vertical decimal alignment.

rules.name: The Hairline Boundary Rule
rules.body: Depth is established by 1px border contrast (var(--border-subtle) / var(--border-muted)), not ambient blur. Surfaces remain flat at rest and respond only to state transitions.

dos: Do format every currency amount with monospace tabular figures (font-mono text-right).
Do preserve 1px hairline structural borders on all card containers and table headers.
Do display transaction identifiers without truncation on copy or hover tooltip.
Do use strict semantic badge colors (Emerald = Matched, Rose = Break, Amber = Ambiguous).
donts: Don't use warm cream backgrounds, serif fonts, or playful decorative illustrations.
Don't left-align currency figures or numerical data columns.
Don't hide critical exception reasons behind nested modal dialogs when inline inspection is possible.
Don't apply the primary Cyanide blue accent to passive, non-interactive surfaces.
